_comment: Hand written hero subjects for the 53 Entryway cards whose title is not a thing. A Tool card called SHOE RACK names its own subject; a Habit card called ONE TRIP RULE does not, and a Skill card called SUSTAIN names an idea. Same lesson the zone heroes cost a full batch to learn: the model draws nouns, so where the card has none, they are supplied. Concrete, countable, under about sixteen words, and never any text or lettering in the scene, because all card wording is set as real type by the template layer.
